clips.title: The story
paras: A summons delivered to promising Alliance warlocks in Ironforge, directing them south to Stormwind. Gakin the Darkbinder awaits beneath the city's Mage Quarter to oversee their advancement into commanding greater fiends.

Demonology remains a practice conducted entirely in shadows across Alliance lands. In Ironforge, Lago Blackwrench quietly keeps tabs on wandering practitioners on behalf of the brotherhood in Stormwind. When a warlock shows sufficient mastery over their initial minions, word travels quickly. Lago passes along the directive: drop whatever business keeps you in the snowy mountains of Khaz Modan and report south without delay.

Deep beneath the cobblestones of Stormwind's Mage Quarter, beneath the tavern known as The Slaughtered Lamb, Gakin the Darkbinder coordinates the development of the city's warlocks. Gakin views every capable student as a valuable, hazardous investment. Receiving his summons marks the threshold of true demonic binding, beginning the trials required to subjugate a succubus from the Twisting Nether.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend! Didn't expect to see you around these parts, but I was instructed to keep an eye out for you.
It's past time you got some more training, so you should stop in to see Gakin the next time you're in Stormwind. He'll be waiting for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad someone was able to get a hold of you, friend. I was beginning to fear the worst. It would be a shame to lose you, after the time we've invested in you.
We can talk later, though. Your training is the only important thing now.
